hints.title: Cyclic Difference Equation
hints.text: Every element original[i] is xored exactly twice in the cyclical chain of derived elements.

hints.title: Total Parity Sum
hints.text: The cumulative xor sum of derived must equal zero because every original element cancels itself out.

hints.title: Equivalence Condition
hints.text: A valid original array exists if and only if the cumulative xor of derived is 0.

hints.title: Bitwise Reduction Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def doesValidArrayExist(self, derived: list[int]) -> bool:
        import functools
        import operator
        return functools.reduce(operator.xor, derived) == 0
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all combinations takes exponential time when mathematical invariant gives exact answer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that the cyclic XOR sum must be 0 for consistency.
